status: Post hoc revision comparison, specified before fitting the comparator or examining ranking agreement.
training: Re-fit a three-stage GeSubNet adaptation on InterGATE's original 2970 training samples and the connected overlap of the distributed BRCA gene list with the undirected HuRI/OmniPath projection. Use the BRCA archive only for gene names. Do not open external expression to fit the networks.
comparison: The comparator receives only the connected genes in the overlapping experiment. InterGATE was fitted in its original 7131-gene context. Project each original InterGATE raw biological score onto the same unordered candidate pairs by taking the maximum across directions. This measures conditional agreement on common pairs; it is not a fully matched genome-wide training benchmark.
model: Released SELM and NeoGNN classes, using 32 encoder dimensions, 32 codewords, 32 embedding coordinates, batch size 32 as in GeSubNet Table 7. Minimize expression reconstruction plus supervised classification and the codebook/commitment loss in the patient module. Train 100 epochs at 1e-4 with Adam (AMSGrad). Train the NeoGNN link predictor on an equal-size random subset of training tumours for 200 epochs, then fit its encoder to reconstruct the focal subtype from fixed 32-coordinate patient encoder outputs for 200 epochs, each at 0.01 with Adam. Predict links symmetrically. The published driver omits the last call and its encoder/decoder unpacking is inconsistent; report our implementation as an adaptation. Use the released decoder as written. The common sigmoid/logit transformation is monotonic.
endpoints: Descriptive between-method Spearman correlation of across-seed median scores over all shared candidate pairs. Select the first 1% at a common budget k=round(0.01 * number of pairs), with 5% and 10% as sensitivity. Report selected-pair overlap and between-seed stability for each method and each budget. Count pairs with >=1 and with both genes in the original directional Basal-like union excluding PAM50. Compare development-to-external Spearman correlation of edge effects for each fixed panel using the study's class-versus-pooled-rest contrast. Retain cohort-specific results and list small denominators. No formal superiority test; no tuning from the external results.
tie_break: Descending score, ascending pair of alphabetically ordered gene symbols.
